parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small circular button on the toaster made of plastic, typically used to control specific functions such as canceling the toasting process.
parts.Functional_description: This button allows the user to stop the toasting cycle or activate a specific mode.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another control button on the toaster, made of plastic, similar in size and function to the first button.
parts.Functional_description: It may control a secondary function such as defrost or reheat mode.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular slider handle on the toaster made of plastic, used to lower the bread into the heating slots.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal mechanism to start the toasting process when pushed down.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically along a guided slot and locks in place during operation.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: Another slider handle on the toaster, identical in function and material to the first slider.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the second toasting slot, allowing independent operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically along a guided slot and locks in place during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster, made of stainless steel, housing the heating elements and internal mechanisms.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, heat insulation, and protection for the internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
